newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada 91-day T-bill yields avg 2.858 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada 91-day T-bill yields avg 2.858 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada said the average yield at this week's auction of C$3.0 billion of 91-day Government of Canada treasury bills due May 29, 1997 was 2.858 percent, down from 2.884 percent last week.

The average yield on C$1.4 billion of 182-day T-bills due August 28, 1997 was 3.098 percent, down from 3.103 percent last week, and on C$1.0 billion of 357-day T-bills due February 19, 1998 was 3.467 percent, up from 3.425 percent.
The Bank bought C$525 million three-month, C$150 million six-month and C$75 million oen-year bills. It holds C$800 million of C$5.1 billion bills due March 6.
